verdict.rationale: Jira is an engineering work tracker that surfaces development status and has Rovo AI, so AI explanation of linked code changes is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains nothing showing Jira's AI breaking a code diff into sections or explaining what changed and why. Its documented Rovo features cover task breakdown, automations, status updates and trend spotting, none of which is diff analysis.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
